method: img2video / reference-driven video, max 7 refs, no text-only
promptLaws: Do not change the character or style.
Animate THIS EXACT IMAGE; do not re-stage the scene.
Motion and camera only in prompt text; identity from attached refs.
Never bipedal/standing on two legs/Bluey/clothing descriptions.
NO CLOTHING negative; preschool-soft expressions; camera locked.
negativePrompt: humans, children, realistic people, clothing, clothes, shirt, dress, blazer, jacket, text, captions, watermark, Bluey, quadruped dog, morphing, extra limbs, scary grin, shouting mouth, restage, cutaway
